 Doh Kyungsoo Live in Manila 2027: Ticket Prices and Seat Plan Announced
 Korea Entertainment Entertainment and Celebrity News Events & Nightlife 
 November 9, 2026 
 Jia Pizarro Bote 
 Good news, Filipino Dandanies! The ticketing details for Doh Kyungsoo’s “Day Off” in Manila are finally out.
 Photo: Doh Kyungsoo/Instagram
 Wilbros Live finally announced the ticket prices and seat plan for the upcoming show slated for January 23, 2027, at the Araneta Coliseum.
 The ticket prices are as follows: 
 VIP Seated: P16,800
 Lower Box Premium: P13,800
 Lower Box Regular: P10,600
 Upper Box Premium: P8,400
 Upper Box Regular: P4,200
 Gen Admission (Free Seating): P3,200
 The fan benefits for VIP Seated include soundcheck, send-off session, VIP ID & lanyard, and exclusive photocards. They also have the chance to win a signed postcard (40 winners).
 Tickets go on sale on Friday, November 20 (12:00 PM) via TicketNet.com.ph and TicketNet outlets.
 Doh Kyungsoo, popularly known as D.O., gained mainstream prominence as a vocalist of the popular K-pop group EXO. As a soloist, he has released multiple hit albums and singles, including “Rose,” “Popcorn,” “I Do,” and “That’s Okay,” among others.
 In September 2026, he released a new mini-album titled “ Dopamine .”
